messages.content: Dexter is the owner of five pigs. Each pig consumes 4 pounds of feed two times a day. Dexter has recently purchased 300 pounds of feed. Can you calculate how many pounds of feed will remain after one week?

content.text:
# Feed Calculation

**Daily feed consumption per pig:** 4 pounds × 2 times = 8 pounds

**Daily feed consumption for all 5 pigs:** 8 × 5 = 40 pounds

**Weekly feed consumption:** 40 × 7 = 280 pounds

**Feed remaining after one week:** 300 − 280 = **20 pounds**

After one week, Dexter will have **20 pounds of feed** remaining.
